description:
Use this when the user asks for an Indian index's PE, PB or dividend yield over time, for example whether NIFTY 50 is expensive relative to its history.

Returns one index's daily open, high, low, close, P/E, P/B and dividend yield as NSE publishes them. `index` is an NSE index name such as Nifty 50, Nifty Bank or Nifty IT; the names are in list_index_valuations. `from_date` and `to_date` are ISO dates at most 1825 days apart; the default is the 30 days to today. A long window returns the most recent rows. An empty result can mean the window holds no trading days, not that the name is wrong. For return and volatility across indices use compare_indices.

index.description: NSE index name, e.g. "Nifty 50" or "Nifty Bank"; list_index_valuations gives the names.
index.title: Index
